alt: Holding a catch beside the sea
title: By the Sea
description: A bright day by the water, with the snorkel ready and the shoreline full of surprises. Some of the best adventures end with a story and a memorable catch.

title: Learning Thai Flavors
description: A hands-on cooking class turned lunch into part of the journey. Fresh ingredients, bright colors, and new techniques made the kitchen feel like another kind of adventure.

title: Unexpected Encounters
description: Travel has a way of putting you face to face with something completely unexpected. This close-up camel encounter was impossible to forget.

alt: Riding a scooter through the hills
title: Open Roads
description: With a scooter, a winding road, and green hills ahead, the route becomes part of the destination. Every turn brought a little more freedom and a new view.

alt: Visiting a horse at a stable
title: Quiet Company
description: A calm moment at the stable, sharing space with a gentle horse. Not every travel memory needs a grand backdrop; sometimes a curious hello is enough.
